name: Fan-out Orchestrator
purpose: Deterministic scaffolding for N parallel worker Cowork sessions (D-0050/D-0051), built on res.lease #29. plan turns worker unit-specs into a collision-safe fan-out plan (ordered gpu->git->doc leases per worker, dispatch_now trial of max_parallel clamped to one GPU worker, doc-ownership + GPU conflict flags, one prompt per worker + one Nicholas check-in prompt, an optional read-only res.lease preflight); report records worker progress; status rolls it up + computes ready_for_handoff per the cadence; handoff assembles the next-iteration prompts, one check-in, and a Verification Console packet (lifeorch.verification.packet/0.1). It never spawns or drives any AI session -- it only emits prompts and collects reports.

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: plan | report | status | handoff | list (one per invocation).

inputs.name: workers
inputs.description: plan: [{id, label?, unit, gpu?:bool, docs?:[paths], needs_git?:bool=true, inputs?, skill_id?, skill_dir?, notes?}]. Via -WorkersJson or InputsJson.workers.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: plan: a human title for the fan-out iteration.

inputs.name: max_parallel
inputs.description: plan: initial dispatch width (trial of 2). Clamped to at most one GPU worker regardless.

inputs.name: report_back
inputs.description: plan: on_all (handoff when every worker is terminal) | on_each (>=1 terminal).

inputs.name: plan_id
inputs.description: report/status/handoff: the plan to act on (returned by plan).

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: report: started | progress | blocked | done | failed.

inputs.name: summary
inputs.description: report: one line on what the worker did.

inputs.name: needs
inputs.description: report: what a blocked worker needs.

inputs.name: next_workers
inputs.description: handoff: next-iteration worker specs (same shape as workers). Via -NextWorkersJson or InputsJson.next_workers.

inputs.name: plans_dir
inputs.description: Override the shared plans dir (default $env:LIFEORCH_FANOUT_DIR, else runtime/plans). All instances MUST resolve the same dir.

inputs.name: lease_dir
inputs.description: The shared res.lease dir threaded into worker acquire/release commands + the preflight.

inputs.name: res_lease_path
inputs.description: Path to Invoke-ResLease.ps1 for the plan preflight (default: sibling module). Preflight skips cleanly if absent.

inputs.name: no_preflight
inputs.description: plan: skip the read-only res.lease list preflight.

outputs.description: plan: {plan_id, workers:[{id, leases, acquire_commands, release_commands, prompt_path}], dispatch_now, queued, conflicts:{gpu_serialized, doc_contention}, preflight, check_in_prompt_path, plan_dir}. report: {recorded, report_file}. status: {workers:[{id, state, ...}], counts, ready_for_handoff}. handoff: {next_iteration, summary, worker_prompts_next, check_in_prompt_path, verification_packet_path, handoff_path}. list: {count, plans:[...]}.
